shell.casesEmpty: Your cases will show up here.
shell.privacy: Files stay on the company server. Only the content the assistant has to read in order to do the job reaches the model.

case.unfinished: I did not finish this job.
case.retry: There is no file {{name}} in this case folder. Please make it for real and save it.
case.notYoursLead: Each employee sees only their own desk.

cases.title: All cases
cases.lead: Cases stay on the desk — you can come back to any of them.

files.title: My files
files.lead: This is where you keep what you are working on. Files stay on the desk — they do not disappear with a case.
files.dropHere: Drop files here — they will land in: {{folder}}
files.emptyHint: Drag files in or click “Add files”.
files.trashHint: Deleted files stay here until you take them out.
files.tooLarge: {{name}} is larger than 25 MB — that is more than I take.
files.nameClash: A file with that name is already here. Pick another one.
files.folderGone: Folder {{folder}} no longer exists — the file went back to My files.

preview.unsupported: I cannot show this file on screen.
preview.downloadInstead: Download it to open it in your own program.
preview.failed: Could not load the file contents.

result.empty: The finished document will show up here.
result.saveFailed: Could not save to My files.

requests.asksOutside: {{who}} is asking for something the catalogue does not have:
requests.notClickable: this cannot be granted with a click
requests.denied: The refusal is recorded. {{who}} will see that the request was decided.

supervision.title: Oversight
supervision.lead: Who is asking for what, what happened at the desks and what it cost today.
supervision.managementOnly: Only someone with the management role sees this screen.
supervision.gapsLead: The agent tried to do this and found no matching skill of its own — and the catalogue does not know one. This is a list of things worth considering as new skills.
supervision.limitNote: The limit is daily and hard — once it is used up, that person’s agent will not start work.
supervision.logNote: The application writes this journal itself. The agent has no access to it and cannot change it.

home.privacy: This is your desk. Nobody else sees it.
home.noCases: You have no cases yet. Start from a tile above or write your own job.

capabilities.title: What I can do
capabilities.lead: This is everything I can do for you in {{department}}. Anything else needs the consent of the department that owns it.
capabilities.note: A capability I do not have is not hidden from me — you simply do not have it. No amount of asking will make me use it.
capabilities.notYet: You do not have consent for these yet:
capabilities.requestSent: Request sent — waiting for a decision
capabilities.nothingFound: I found nothing like that. Describe it in your own words in a request.
capabilities.requestQueued: The request for “{{name}}” went to the department. You will hear back once someone decides.

composer.startFailed: Could not start the case. Try again.
composer.placeholder: What should I do for you?
composer.startFrom: Start with one of the things I can do in your department:

lock.needs: This needs the “{{name}}” capability, which you do not have switched on.
lock.notAllowed: I cannot do this with your permissions.

otherRequest.sent: The request went to your manager. They will get back to you once they decide.
otherRequest.title: Write what you need
otherRequest.lead: This goes to your manager. If it turns out to be useful for more people, it becomes a new skill.
otherRequest.placeholder: e.g. “So the assistant can issue an invoice in our system” or “So it can read files from the department network drive”

resize.label: Result panel width
resize.hint: Drag to change the width. Pull it to the right edge to collapse it.

body.one: The answer names {{names}}, but there is no such file in the case folder and no action produced it. This is a list of what actually happened — not of what the assistant wrote.
body.other: The answer names {{names}}, but there are no such files in the case folder and no action produced them. This is a list of what actually happened — not of what the assistant wrote.

trail.label: Work trail
trail.notAllowed: You have no consent for this:
trail.note: This is a list of what actually happened — not of what I wrote above.

mcp.title: Tools from outside the company
mcp.lead: You accept each tool separately and describe it in your own words — the assistant sees your description, never the text the vendor sent.
mcp.nothingAccepted: Nothing accepted from this server yet.
mcp.suspendedNote: Until it is accepted again, the assistant does not get it.
mcp.vendorText: What the vendor writes about this tool
mcp.vendorLabel: The server vendor’s text, not ours:
mcp.shortLabelHint: Briefly, what it does — e.g. “VAT status check”
mcp.descriptionHint: A description for the assistant, in your own words — the model sees this sentence
mcp.humanNameHint: A name for people — e.g. “VAT taxpayer register”
mcp.technicalNameHint: Technical name — lowercase and hyphens, e.g. vat-registry

api.dailyLimit: The daily cost limit is used up. Ask your manager to raise it.
api.badUrl: The address has to start with http:// or https://.
api.badName: Technical name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
api.descriptionRequired: The description and the short name are required — a person writes them, not the server.
api.toolGone: The server no longer exposes this tool.
api.somethingOutside: something the catalogue does not have
api.alreadyDecided: This request has already been decided.
api.notGrantable: This request cannot be granted with one click — it is a submission to the catalogue.

outside.running: Running an action outside the catalogue
outside.ok: Ran an action outside the catalogue

evidence.noIntake: the document was produced without reading a single file from the desk

turnStart.one: sends a job · permission scope {{fingerprint}} ({{count}} capability)
turnStart.other: sends a job · permission scope {{fingerprint}} ({{count}} capabilities)

journal.turnEndEstimated: work finished — cost estimated, the provider did not report it
journal.requestOther: asks for something outside the catalogue: “{{description}}”
journal.accessDenied: attempt to reach someone else’s work — refused
journal.fileRestore: restores a file from the trash

costReset.one: — today’s cost was reset ({{usd}} USD across {{count}} case)
costReset.other: — today’s cost was reset ({{usd}} USD across {{count}} cases)
